name: InlineCitation
description: Perplexity-style inline citation chip that reveals the source title and snippet on hover or keyboard focus.
designIntent: Attribute individual claims inside a response to their source without leaving the paragraph.

props.name: source
props.description: Cited source powering the preview card.

props.name: children
props.description: Wrapped text; defaults to the source title.

antiPatterns.title: Do not stack many citations on one word
antiPatterns.explanation: Use Sources footer for long lists; keep inline citations to one claim each.

accessibility.implementation: Trigger is a focusable button; card opens on focus-within.
Card has role=tooltip linked via aria-describedby.
